evasion_targets: ST-01 trusted-owner short-circuit for a genuine Electron owner (review of the 1.1.7 integration, M3)
notes: An unsigned dropper writes s.js and starts the genuine, Discord-signed Discord.exe with it as the only argument (ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1, which the sensor cannot see). The Node-mode Discord reads Discord's own Local State and leveldb token store, unprotects the key and uploads to a raw host. It must not be treated as the owner of its store.
